name: Nisshin Seifun Group Inc.
summary: Nisshin Seifun Group Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in the flour milling, processed foods, prepared dishes and other prepared foods, and other businesses in Japan and internationally. The company manufactures and sells wheat-related products, including bran, wheat germ, rye flour, and other food-related items; home-use and commercial-use premixes, pastas, and pasta sauces marketed under the Nisshin, Ma?Ma, Ao-no-Dokutsu, De Cecco, and Welna brands; bakery fillings, cooking fillings, and mayonnaise for use in the bakery industry and other areas; and biotechnology business.
